_doc: Models for Canopy Crossing, made with Meshy text to 3D (preview + texture). tools/meshy/generate.py reads this; see tools/meshy/README.md.
style: Photorealistic, highly detailed, game-ready single object on its own, no ground plane, no background.

assets.prompt: A giant red soldier ant walking, carrying a wedge of yellow cheese with round holes in its curved black mandibles. Glossy deep-red segmented exoskeleton, large head, elbowed antennae, six jointed legs mid-stride, slim waist, round abdomen.
A Caribbean land crab: wide domed red-orange shell, two big raised claws, eight jointed walking legs splayed to the sides, short stalked eyes, standing on the ground.

A spectacled caiman crocodile lying flat with legs spread: dark olive-brown armored scutes along the back and long tail, broad snout with visible teeth, raised eyes and nostrils, pale yellow belly edges.
An African forest elephant walking: grey wrinkled skin, rounded ears, straight downward-pointing tusks, trunk hanging down, four thick legs mid-stride, short tail.
A collared peccary wild pig trotting: coarse bristly dark grey-brown coat with a pale band around the neck, short pig snout, small ears, slim legs with hooves.
A dhole, the Asian wild dog, trotting: rusty red-orange coat, cream throat and belly, bushy black-tipped tail, rounded ears, slender legs.
A gaur, the wild jungle ox, walking: massive dark brown-black body with a high shoulder ridge, curved pale horns, white lower legs like stockings.
A coiled jungle viper raising its head ready to strike: thick body with brown, cream and black diamond pattern, broad triangular head, forked tongue, coils on the ground.
A harpy eagle in flight with wings fully spread: grey head with a split crest, black chest band, white belly, broad wings barred black and grey, large yellow talons, seen in a gliding pose.
A southern cassowary walking: shaggy glossy black feathers, bright blue bare neck with two red wattles, tall brown horn-like casque on its head, powerful grey legs with big three-toed feet.
An Asian water monitor lizard walking: long muscular body, dark grey-black scaly skin with pale yellow spots in bands, long flattened tail, forked tongue, four splayed legs.
A Bengal tiger crouched low and about to pounce: orange coat with black stripes, white belly and face markings, muscular legs, long striped tail.
A blue poison dart frog sitting: bright cobalt-blue skin with black spots, darker blue legs, large dark eyes, toe pads, glossy wet skin.
A western lowland gorilla walking on its knuckles: dark grey-black fur, silver-grey back, broad muscular shoulders, expressive face with deep-set eyes.
A Bornean orangutan standing on all fours: long shaggy reddish-orange hair, long arms, wide cheek pads, gentle dark face.
A ring-tailed lemur walking on all fours with its long tail raised in a curve: soft grey fur, white belly, black-and-white ringed tail, white face with black eye patches and bright orange eyes.
A giant rainforest kapok tree: massive straight grey trunk with huge flared buttress roots at the base, mossy bark with lichens, a broad dense green crown high above.
A strangler fig tree: a lattice of thick tangled aerial roots wrapping a trunk, hanging roots, mossy bark, leafy green canopy.
A tall slender tropical palm tree: smooth ringed grey trunk, crown of long arching green feather-like fronds.
A tree fern: a thin furry brown trunk about three meters tall topped with a wide crown of long lacy green fronds.
A dense clump of giant green bamboo: many tall jointed green and yellow canes with narrow leaves near the top.
A heliconia plant: broad paddle-shaped green leaves on long stems with hanging bright red and yellow lobster-claw flowers.
A lush clump of ground ferns: many arching bright green fronds from a central base.
A bromeliad plant: a rosette of stiff glossy green and red striped leaves with a bright pink flower spike in the middle.
A large monstera elephant-ear plant: big glossy dark green split leaves on long stalks, growing from the forest floor.
A mangrove tree standing on arching stilt roots above muddy water: twisted grey roots, dark green leathery leaves.
A large rounded granite boulder covered in thick bright green moss on top, grey lichen-spotted stone below.
A cluster of smooth wet grey river stones of different sizes, some with patches of green moss.
A fallen tree log lying horizontally: rough brown bark, broken branch stubs, patches of green moss and small mushrooms, ringed cut ends.
An old rotting tree stump with orange shelf fungi, moss and small ferns growing from it.
A cluster of round green water lily pads floating flat with one open pink water lily flower.
An ancient Maya stone pyramid temple ruin in the jungle: stepped grey limestone tiers, a small shrine on top with a doorway, carved blocks, moss and vines growing over the stones.
A carved ancient Maya stone stela: a tall standing grey stone slab covered in relief carvings of glyphs and a figure, weathered with moss.
A tall jungle rock cliff for a waterfall: layered dark wet basalt rock face with a central notch where water would pour, ferns and moss on the ledges, a rocky pool rim at the bottom.
A tall jagged limestone karst tower: vertical grey and black rock spire with jungle plants clinging to its ledges.
A muddy old logging truck loaded with stacked tree trunks: red cab, flatbed trailer with chained logs, big off-road tires.
An open-top green safari jeep for rainforest tours: roll bar, spare tire on the back, muddy off-road tires.

A dense wall of tropical rainforest undergrowth about four meters wide and two meters tall: layered ferns, young palms, broad leaves, hanging vines and a few thin trunks, packed together like a living hedge.
A long narrow wooden river longboat with an outboard motor at the back and a small curved palm-thatch canopy in the middle, painted planks, used on jungle rivers.
A red kangaroo mid-hop: powerful hind legs bent and pushing off, long thick tail held out straight behind for balance, short front arms tucked in, upright ears, reddish-tan fur with a pale belly.
